sn46.46:1.1: Daliddo daliddo ti bhante vuccati || kittāvatā nu kho bhante Daliddo ti vuccatī ti || || Sattannaṃ kho bhikkhu bojjhaṅgānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā Daliddo ti vuccati || Katamesam sattannaṃ || || Satisambojjhaṅgassa || la-pe || || Upekhādambojjhāṅgassa || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhu sattannam bojjhaṅgānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā Daliddo ti vuccatī ti || || Adaliddo
